title: agentic-ai-homelab
summary: The operator's homelab: the Mac mini's self-hosted services (observability, GlitchTip, Langfuse, LiteLLM, Umami, the Hub), the DGX and X3 model hosts, the workstation's agent configuration and skills, and the decisions behind them. The agent fleets themselves live in chipi/flotilla.
notes: Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md (repo-wide) and the scoped AGENTS.md files it lists; the operator's global rules are workstation/config/AGENTS.md. The operations handbook, docs/recipes/agent-access.md, is how to read and change every running service with access that already exists: start there for anything about a live service. Docs are an MkDocs site under docs/ (ADRs, RFCs, recipes, history, wip); each infra stack documents itself in its own README.md.
This file is generated by scripts/llms_txt.py from llms.config.json; `make llms-txt` rewrites it and CI fails when it is stale.

purposes.workstation/storage/README.md: the Btrfs subvolume layout of the Linux workstation (/work, docker, containerd outside the OS rollback); why: ADR-0011
purposes.workstation/tmux/README.md: tmux sessions that survive a crash or reboot of the Linux workstation; why: ADR-0012
purposes.infra/langfuse/views/README.md: Langfuse dashboards and saved views, created as code by build.py
purposes.docs/recipes/x3-storage-safety-copy-reti: removing the pre-subvolume safety copies on the X3 after the storage separation
purposes.docs/wip/eval-harness-feedback-fleet.md: the fleet session's running log of eval-harness friction and asks, each marked fixed, recorded or open
